description.value: A two-suite B&B set on 2.3 acres in the rural Hyde Creek community near Port McNeill, offering sweeping ocean views of Broughton Strait and a three-minute walk to a wildlife-rich beach frequented by orcas, eagles, and dolphins. The property is run exclusively by Rolf Hicker, an award-winning professional wildlife and nature photographer with over 35 years of experience, who offers private custom photo tours — grizzly watching, whale watching, Cape Scott — available only to his guests. It sits at the gateway to the Broughton Archipelago and is within easy reach of Telegraph Cove and Port Hardy.
